submission.justification: Algorithm-L3 with a 30 GeV threshold is recommended as it achieves the highest signal efficiency (85.502%) among all viable algorithm-threshold combinations while meeting all constraints. This represents a 10.921% efficiency advantage over the best alternative (Algorithm-L1 at 30 GeV with 74.581% efficiency). Algorithm-L2 was excluded as it fails to meet the hard latency requirement of 4.0 μs. The systematic evaluation across the threshold range (20-60 GeV) confirmed that 30 GeV is the optimal operating point for Algorithm-L3, maximizing signal efficiency at the allocated 8 kHz trigger rate.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L3 at 30 GeV achieves 85.502% efficiency, which is the maximum among all viable combinations evaluated
requirements.evidence_source: simulation results showing max_efficiency_L3 = 85.502 and best_overall_efficiency = 85.502

requirements.requirement: Algorithm must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L3 is one of the three candidate algorithms (L1, L2, L3) specified in the project documents

requirements.requirement: Algorithm's latency on Level-1 FPGA hardware must not exceed 4.0 μs
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L3 meets the latency requirement (algorithm_L3_meets_latency = 1, final_latency_compliant = 1)
requirements.evidence_source: latency analysis showing algorithm_L3_meets_latency = 1 and max_latency_us = 4

requirements.evidence: Recommended threshold of 30 GeV is within the specified range [20, 60] GeV (final_threshold_in_range = 1)
requirements.evidence_source: threshold optimization showing optimal_threshold_L3_GeV = 30 within constraints threshold_min_GeV = 20 and threshold_max_GeV = 60
